name: Harbourside
description: An example world pack: a port town, two clocks that tick between scenes, and a small cast. Copy it and change everything.

effects.0: Ships come and go as they please.
effects.1: A navy cutter sits at the harbour mouth; captains grumble.
effects.2: Cargo is searched on the quay; prices of salt and lamp oil rise.
effects.3: No ship leaves without a stamped paper from the customs house.
effects.4: Two merchantmen were turned back; the fish market is half empty.
effects.5: Soldiers board at random; a smuggler was hanged on the mole.
effects.6: The harbour is closed. Nothing comes in but the navy.

effects.1: A few dockers are abed with a sweat.
effects.2: The infirmary is full; the priests burn herbs on the quay.
effects.3: Houses in the old town have crosses on their doors.
effects.4: The hill has shut its gates against the lower town.

blurb: Harbourside talks of nothing but the cutter at the harbour mouth.
